_comment: HUD dmi 中文化配置。每个 state: {text, lines?, size?/sizes?, color?(#rrggbb), outline?(#hex/false/auto), rect?(检测限框), search?(检测范围), maskrect?(强制擦除区), mask_color/mask_bright/mask_red?(像素过滤), fill?(scanline/flat/transparent), bg?(#hex), box?(落字框), dx/dy?, keep_blue_x?, button?, parts?}。keep:true 表示显式跳过。
